description: This file contains generated C# code for Orleans journaling components, including abstract classes, interfaces, enums, and serializers related to durable state management, state machines, and storage providers within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: DurableGrain
classes.description: An abstract class representing a durable grain with state machine management capabilities.

classes.name: DurableTaskCompletionSourceState
classes.description: A serializable struct representing the state of a durable task completion source, including status, value, and exception.

classes.name: DurableTaskCompletionSourceStatus
classes.description: An enum indicating the status of a durable task completion source (Pending, Completed, Faulted, Canceled).

classes.name: HostingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for hosting, such as adding state machine storage.

classes.name: LogExtent
classes.description: Represents a log extent in the state machine storage, with nested Entry struct for individual log entries.

classes.name: LogExtentBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing log extents, supporting buffer writing and stream copying.

classes.name: StateMachineId
classes.description: A struct representing a unique identifier for a state machine.

classes.name: StateMachineStorageWriter
classes.description: A helper struct for writing entries to state machine storage.

classes.name: VolatileStateMachineStorage
classes.description: An implementation of IStateMachineStorage that stores data in volatile memory.

classes.name: VolatileStateMachineStorageProvider
classes.description: A provider class for creating volatile state machine storage instances.

methods.name: GetOrCreateStateMachine
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a durable state machine of specified type.

methods.name: AddStateMachineStorage
methods.description: Extension method to add state machine storage to the silo builder.
